title: Sunrise
novel:
On the morning before the wedding, Barney had gotten [[drunk|drunk]] again and [[wandered|wander]] off. Robin and Ted went looking for him and found themselves walking along the beach as the sun began to rise.

As they walked, Robin and Ted [[reminisced|reminisce]] about their past [[relationships|relationship]]. They talked about the time they dated and why it did not work out. Ted admitted that he had always cared about Robin, but he understood that their [[paths|path]] were meant to go in different directions.

Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily finally [[resolved|resolve]] their issues. They sat down and had an honest conversation about the judge job. Marshall [[apologized|apologize]] for not telling Lily sooner, and Lily [[acknowledged|acknowledge]] that Marshall had good intentions. They agreed to always [[communicate|communicate]] openly with each other.

Barney, who had been wandering around town, [[befriended|befriend]] two young men at a diner. He gave them [[advice|advice]] about love and life, drawing from his own experiences. The young men were [[impressed|impress]] by Barney's wisdom, even though he was still slightly drunk.

Back on the beach, Ted and Robin watched the [[sunrise|sunrise]] together. The sky turned beautiful shades of orange and pink. Ted told Robin that he was truly happy for her and Barney. He said he was ready to [[let go|let go]] of his feelings for her.

Robin was [[moved|move]] by Ted's words. She told him that he would find his own [[happiness|happiness]] someday. They shared a warm [[embrace|embrace]] as the sun rose over the ocean.

The morning ended with the group coming together for breakfast. Marshall and Lily were smiling again, Barney had returned safely, and Ted felt a sense of peace he had not felt in a long time.

drunk.en: He was drunk at the party.

path.en: Their paths went in different directions.

let go.en: She needed to let go of the past.
